Disclaimer* RTW Biotech Opportunities Ltd 14 October 2026 LEI: 549300Q7EXQQH6KF7Z84 14 October 2026 RTW Biotech Opportunities Ltd Monthly Valuation Update and Factsheet RTW Biotech Opportunities Ltd (the " Company ") announces that its monthly factsheet and quarterly letter as at 30 September 2026 is now available at https://www.rtwbio.com/factsheets-letters/ . The Company’s unaudited net asset value attributable to its ordinary shares as at 30 September 2026 was US$2.70 per share, a decrease of -7.7% from the previous month vs -0.1% for the Nasdaq Biotech Index and -5.3% for the Russell 2000 Biotech Index. The Company has delivered +14.2% annualised NAV per ordinary share performance since launch in October 2019. COMPANY UPDATE On 14 September, the Company published its interim results for the six months ended 30 June 2026, where the NAV per Ordinary Share rose +16.5%. The presentation and webinar recording are available in the Results and Presentations section of the website. On 19 August, the Company appointed Jefferies International Limited as joint corporate broker, alongside BofA Securities. As outlined in the Company’s Capital Allocation Plan updated in October 2025, should a significant cash inflow (e.g. through a portfolio position being acquired) be received, it remains the Board’s intention to consider returning a portion of the realised gains to shareholders through NAV-accretive share buybacks. In light of the material uptick seen in sector M&A, over the twelve months 30 September 2026, RTW Bio repurchased 6.2 million shares, equivalent to $13.4 million (8.4 million shares, equivalent to $10.8 million, for the twelve months to 30 September 2025). The Company continues to apply a disciplined evaluation framework to determine the optimal capital allocation framework. PERFORMANCE UPDATE Over the third quarter, the Company’s NAV per share returned -5.6% vs –2.8% for the Russell 2000 Biotech Index (R2kB), +8.5% for the Nasdaq Biotech Index (NBI), and -1.1% for the AIC Biotechnology and Healthcare sector. The discount to NAV at which RTW Bio’s Ordinary Shares trade closed from 27.5% to 11.8% over the twelve months to 30 September 2026. The Company’s NAV per share has delivered an annualised return of 14.2% per annum since launch on 30 October 2019, compared with the R2kB 9.7% p/a, the NBI 12.5% p/a, and the AIC Biotechnology and Healthcare sector 3.7% p/a. SECTOR UPDATE Biotech indices were broadly flat over the third quarter (SPDR S&P Biotech ETF (XBI) –0.36%), but the headline masked wide dispersion beneath the surface. Many therapeutic names weakened during August and September, while a small group of large constituents supported the index. Moderna, a popular short position, was the main driver of sector performance. The shares rose more than 170% in August on pivotal Phase 3 melanoma data for intismeran, which many specialist investors had not anticipated. Moderna is now the fourth largest biotech company by market capitalisation. Losses on the move led a number of managers to reduce exposure. A short-covering rally in heavily shorted names followed, and in September multi-strategy funds cutting risk added further selling pressure on widely held positions.
